# Zhouyi Xiaoxiao · 周易潇潇

> PhD researcher, University of Bristol — first-passage times of random walks and the evaluation of AI agents · R&D Scientist (AI), Yuexin International.

zhouyixiaoxiao.com is a live first-passage experiment run on one life: walkers leave Tianjin and search a luminous plate of 2021 to now for whatever you choose. Switch on the shortcuts actually taken, and the chart of arrival times splits into two peaks — which is the PhD result, and the way around this site.

First Passage · 首达 — So far · Edition 01 · as at 8 Oct 2026. English at https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/, Chinese (简体中文) mirror at https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/. This file is generated from the same content as the pages; facts link to the page that shows them. Also known as: Xiaoxiao Zhouyi, 周易潇潇.

[Poster list](https://ukairs2026.eventsadmin.com/i/PosterSessions)

- *Spectral diagnostics and local fixed-budget sensitivity of critical points in finite encounter-reaction models* — Xiaoxiao Zhouyi — Working paper (2026-07)

## All chapters

- [01 · First Passage — PhD research: when a random walker first arrives](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/): Why one target can have two arrival peaks, and exactly when the second dies: a single-author paper submitted to Physical Review E (a physics journal). Chinese: [首达——博士研究：随机游走何时第一次到达](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/research/)
- [02 · Skipping the IME? — First AI paper · UKAIRS 2026, the UK AI Research Symposium](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/): Can AI agents read raw pinyin (romanised Chinese)? The Edinburgh poster says: for routine prompts, yes; homophones need the key word in characters. Chinese: [跳过输入法？——第一篇 AI 论文 · 英国 AI 研究研讨会（UKAIRS 2026）](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/ai/skipping-the-ime/)
- [03 · The Engine Room — R&D Scientist (AI) at Yuexin International, a cloud-communications company](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/): Since June 2026 at Yuexin International: five AI systems built and live in four months — a gateway, a governed platform, a staff assistant. Chinese: [引擎室——阅信国际 · AI 研发](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/work/engine-room/)
- [04 · On Stage — Brand design, trade shows and talks](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/on-stage/): Giving a cloud-communications company an AI-era face: a logo system, materials for two trade shows (MWC Shanghai, WWC Madrid), a 93-minute AI primer. Chinese: [展台——品牌设计、展会与演讲](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/zh/work/on-stage/)
- [05 · Teaching — Graduate Teacher & Demonstrator](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/teaching/): In front of students from the first month of the PhD; for 2026–27, 13 roles across three schools: tutorials, labs, problem classes, marking. ## Threads

- **Maths → AI** — The same habit — measure the hidden route — aimed first at random walkers, then at AI agents. [Physics-informed neural networks for differential equations](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#e-education_life-hkust-pinns-report) · [Research internship at LiveX AI, a Bay Area AI start-up](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/westward/#e-us_ai_internship_career-livex-ai-internship-2025) · [46 theorems, checked by machine](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#e-research_fpt-dpma-lean) · [Accepted at UKAIRS 2026: the first AI paper](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#e-ai_research-ukairs-acceptance)
- **Built for others** — A guide for the next cohort, a tool for farms, an assistant for colleagues, a library for one tutorial group. [The Tianjin University maths guide](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/workshop/#e-projects_code-tju-math-guide) · [The BioPath platform: map in, traps out, proof attached](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/enterprise/#e-projects_code-biopath-platform) · [Yuexin AI Assistant — web and Windows](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/#e-company_products-yuexin-chat-launch) · [An offline, bilingual teaching library](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/teaching/#e-school_teaching_service-offline-teaching-library)
- **Bilingual bridge** — Many projects ship in English and Chinese — including a paper about the space between them. [A public, bilingual research atlas](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#e-research_fpt-research-atlas) · [The UKAIRS paper: prompting AI agents in pinyin (romanised Chinese)](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#e-ai_research-ukairs-submission) · [A home-built bilingual subtitle pipeline](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/media/#e-self_media-bilingual-subtitle-engine) · [‘Intelligence. Delivered.’ — print and digital kit for a Madrid trade show](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/on-stage/#e-company_design_events-wwc-materials-design)
- **On stage** — From a first press mention in Chengdu to stand-up in Bristol, a PechaKucha (20 slides × 20 seconds), a 93-minute primer and two trade floors. [A first press mention, in Chengdu](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/roots/#e-education_life-chengdu-expo-media-speeches) · [Seven minutes of stand-up about a maths PhD](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/campus/representing/#e-school_teaching_service-lighter-side-of-research) · [A PechaKucha (20 slides × 20 seconds) at the Festival of Enterprise](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/enterprise/#e-school_teaching_service-festival-of-enterprise-2026) · [‘From SMS to Intelligent Channels’: a 93-minute primer on AI models](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/on-stage/#e-company_design_events-llm-industry-training-talk)
- **Proof & audit** — Trust, but verify: computer-checked theorems, 325 million simulated walkers, negative results kept, AI reviewers before every launch. [Programming the number of peaks](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/research/#e-research_fpt-fixed-budget-theorem-campaign) · [A negative result: restoring the Chinese first made it worse](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/ai/skipping-the-ime/#e-ai_research-phase3-normalize-backfires) · [An enterprise platform for governed AI access](https://zhouyixiaoxiao.com/work/engine-room/#e-company_products-governance-platform-live)
